suite: SQLFluff semantic fixes (AL, AM, CV, RF, ST)
score: 235/369 meaning-keeping fixes proved (235/238 on the pairs the prover can read), 0 wrong; 18/28 fixes that change meaning by design refuted, none proved
metric: Each fail/fix pair from sqlfluff 4.3.0's structure rules (aliasing, ambiguity, conventions, references, structure): the prover must prove the fixes that keep the meaning and must never prove the ones that change it by design (= NULL to IS NULL, reordering the select list, USING or RIGHT JOIN under a bare *).
correctness: 0 recorded wrong: accepted proofs are submitted to a 360-trial random DuckDB recheck, and no by-design change is proved. An execution refusal remains not re-checkable rather than establishing accuracy; finding no witness is not an independent proof. Labels come from what each rule does, never from a verdict. No meaning-keeping pair is refuted. This is an inferred-schema execution check, not a live BigQuery oracle.
held_out: The 2026-10-04 aggregate run includes all held-out rules without inspecting or tuning their SQL; separate split counts were not retained. Historical 2026-10-02 held-out result: 50/83 meaning-keeping fixes proved (50/50 supported) and 6/6 by-design changes refuted, 0 wrong. Rules AL01, AM05, CV02, CV04, CV05, CV06, CV08, TQ02 are held out by rule-code hash.
caveats: Measured on master fa387059 plus PR #605's Windows isolation and PR #609's raw-string canonicalization, using sqlglot 28.10.0 and DuckDB 1.5.1 (1398 seconds). The increase over the older published 218 proofs also includes merged prover improvements and is not attributed solely to raw strings. The fixtures have no schema: one is inferred from mentioned columns plus two placeholders. Fixtures are authored by SQLFluff, not ground-truth equivalence. 136 pairs are unsupported; 30 adapted cases were compared query by query (22 proved, 1 refuted, 7 unsupported), outside the main score. This is a DuckDB check, not a live BigQuery oracle. No held-out SQL was inspected for this fix or rerun. Historically one held-out case was read after it exposed a labeling error.
